name: grand_totals_with_ratios
purpose: Summarize the comparable business with the main current, prior, change, and ratio measures in one place for the report headline.
intent: Grand totals in one row for [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], filtered to the comparable branches CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 across the branch-bearing tables 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no], 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], with no grouping and one row.
dax:
EVALUATE
CALCULATETABLE(
    ROW(
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "net bills PAST", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
        "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
    ),
    TREATAS(
        {"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"},
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]
    ),
    TREATAS(
        {"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"},
        'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]
    ),
    TREATAS(
        {"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"},
        'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]
    ),
    TREATAS(
        {"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"},
        'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]
    )
)
